request: Pull Transport for London AccidentStats for 2019 (the last complete published year from TfL Unified API), api.tfl.gov.uk/AccidentStats/2019 — ~51k road-traffic accidents across Greater London. Each row includes lat/lon, location string, ISO datetime, severity (Fatal/Serious/Slight), borough, casualties list and vehicles list. Enrich with casualty_count and vehicle_count via list_length, severity_band via map_values (Fatal=critical/Serious=high/Slight=low), primary_vehicle via list_first_field on vehicles, primary_casualty_mode via list_first_field on casualties, hour_of_day extracted from the ISO date via substring, and time_of_day_bucket via map_values on hour_of_day (00-05=night, 06-09=morning_peak, 10-15=daytime, 16-19=evening_peak, 20-23=evening). Publish to 'Prep Agent / 36 - UK TfL Accident Statistics 2019' on Tableau Server for TfL / MoT / DfT / MPS analysts. Keyless, OGL v3.

sources.name: TfL AccidentStats 2019
sources.description: api.tfl.gov.uk/AccidentStats/2019 — full year of Transport for London road-traffic accident records, ~51k rows. Response is a top-level JSON array; each element carries id, lat, lon, location (verbose), date (ISO 8601 Z), severity, borough, casualties (list of {age, class, severity, mode, ageBand}), vehicles (list of {type}). Keyless, OGL v3.

args.name: TfL Accidents Trend
args.features_description: Row-level TfL AccidentStats 2019 records — ~51k road-traffic accidents across Greater London. Fields: accident_id (unique), accident_date (YYYY-MM-DD), accident_datetime (ISO 8601 Z), hour_str, time_of_day_bucket (night/morning_peak/daytime/evening_peak/evening), lat, lon, location (verbose street description), severity (Fatal/Serious/Slight), severity_band (critical/high/low), borough (London borough), casualty_count, vehicle_count, primary_vehicle_type (Car/Motorcycle/PedalCycle/etc.), primary_casualty_mode, primary_casualty_class (Driver/Passenger/Pedestrian), primary_casualty_ageband (Child/Adult/Elderly/Unknown).
args.stats_description: Long-form TfL accident statistics (dimension x value x year x month) over severity_band, borough, time_of_day_bucket, primary_vehicle_type. Rolling 30-day counts, z-anomalies vs baseline. Use to spot borough-level or time-of-day-level shifts in accident mix; combine severity_band=critical with borough for a fatal-collision heatmap.

outputs.name: UK TfL Accidents Detail
outputs.description: Row-level TfL AccidentStats 2019 — ~51k Greater London road-traffic accidents. Fields: accident_id, accident_date, accident_datetime, hour_str, time_of_day_bucket (night/morning_peak/daytime/evening_peak/evening), lat, lon, location, severity (Fatal/Serious/Slight), severity_band (critical/high/low), borough, casualty_count, vehicle_count, primary_vehicle_type, primary_casualty_mode, primary_casualty_class, primary_casualty_ageband. Enrichments: casualty_count, vehicle_count, severity_band, primary_vehicle_type, time_of_day_bucket. Source: api.tfl.gov.uk/AccidentStats/2019, OGL v3. Refresh: annual (data is a completed year).

outputs.name: UK TfL Accidents Stats
outputs.description: Long-form TfL accident statistics (dimension x value x year x month) over severity_band, borough, time_of_day_bucket, primary_vehicle_type. Rolling 30-day counts, z-anomalies vs lifetime baseline (|z|>=2.0 flagged is_anomaly=True). Joinable from Tableau on (dimension, value, year, month).
